resources.string: Based only on saved open tasks. A timed deadline is the END of an estimated focus block (25 minutes when unset). All-day tasks stay flexible. This does not read your device calendar or move existing tasks.
%1$d estimated focus minutes · %2$d all-day tasks · %3$d conflicts
Tap to review the first task; nothing is changed automatically.
No slot fits this duration and window. Try another day, a shorter duration, or a different window.
A snapshot of tasks DUE in the last 7 complete days, not when they were completed. Archived tasks are excluded. Focus minutes are estimates, not recorded sessions.
No tasks were due in this period. Start with a small plan.
